content_of_post_to_comment: Just heard this from an academic who strongly recommends that his students do not publish their work - anywhere - because it enters the LLM void and therefore can be used by anyone for free and loses its value. Interesting. What do you think? PS - welcome to the knowledge hoarding period of LLM and AI.
comment: The interesting tension is that openness may reduce scarcity but increase reach. The real question may be whether a work's value lies in exclusive access or in being part of the evolving intellectual record.
